articles.headline: Turkish authorities arrest head of refereeing body amid investigation
articles.description: Authorities in Türkiye have arrested the head of the country's football refereeing body, his deputy and five other people amid efforts to "restore the public trust in football," the country's justice minister said on Tuesday.
